state_script:
Import-Module 'C:/ffpr/deploy/laptop/FfprCommon.psm1' -Force
$src = Join-Path (Find-GameDir ff5) 'BepInEx\ffpr'
$f = Get-ChildItem $src -Filter 'probe-*.jsonl' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
$fs = [IO.File]::Open($f.FullName, 'Open', 'Read', 'ReadWrite')
$start = [Math]::Max(0, $fs.Length - 98304)
[void]$fs.Seek($start, 'Begin')
$buf = New-Object byte[] ($fs.Length - $start)
[void]$fs.Read($buf, 0, $buf.Length)
$fs.Close()
$f.Name
[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($buf)
